name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: New round of strikes targeting Iran underway, U.S. officials say
changes.summary: A 10th straight night of U.S. strikes on Iran is underway as President Trump vows Tehran will pay for the deaths of three American soldiers over the weekend. CBS News senior national security correspondent Charlie D'Agata reports. Then, global affairs analyst Jonathan Wachtel joins to discuss the state of the war.

changes.title: U.S. gas prices back up to average of $4 a gallon, AAA says
changes.summary: As fighting with Iran ramps up, a gallon of regular gas is once again $4 on average, up 13 cents in one week, according to AAA. Severin Borenstein, professor at UC Berkeley's Haas School of Business, joins with analysis.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Iran-backed Houthis say they will blockade anothe waterway, threatening Red Sea shipping, Pete Hegseth heads to the Hill looking for $350 billion funding boost, Arizona voters head to the polls.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Pulling Back on Energy Efficiency
changes.summary: The Trump administration is undoing fuel-saving efforts even as war in Iran, data centers and heat waves are pushing up gasoline and electricity costs.

changes.title: Houthis in Yemen Edge Closer to Entering U.S.-Iran War
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen has declared a Red Sea blockade on Saudi Arabia, potentially opening up a new front in the war rippling across the Middle East.

changes.title: How recent killings of U.S. soldiers could affect the war with Iran
changes.summary: President Trump reacted to the recent killings of U.S. soldiers in the Middle East with strong words on Monday, promising that Iran will pay "many times over." Mark Cancian, senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, joins CBS News to break down what this means for the war and CBS News' Weiji.

changes.title: Gas prices top $4 a gallon again as U.S.-Iran conflict escalates
changes.summary: The national average for a gallon of gas reached $4.003 on Monday, the first time in over a month it has crossed that threshold, AAA data shows.

changes.title: G.O.P. Boxed In on Iran War as Trump Sidelines Congress
changes.summary: Republicans now face a worst-case political scenario of being asked to fund an unpopular war over which they have exercised little oversight.

changes.title: Iran war hurting U.S. allies in region, former Jordanian foreign minister says
changes.summary: For perspective on the latest developments in the Iran war and the regional ramifications, Amna Nawaz spoke with Marwan Muasher. He's the vice president for studies at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace and the former deputy prime minister and foreign minister of Jordan.

changes.title: Oil Prices Cross $90 a Barrel as U.S.-Iran Conflict Widens
changes.summary: Brent crude, the global benchmark for oil, rose more than 3 percent as trading resumed on Sunday, while S&P 500 futures remained essentially unchanged.
